messages:
Akash: FYI — Halcyon Energy (sales lead) dropped a private deployment ask: VPC + strict egress rules + HSM/KMS integration. They want an initial timeline and must-have checklist, target 12-week window. Can product triage?
Morgan: thanks Akash. can you paste the customer's network baseline and compliance notes? we need to split must-haves vs nice-to-haves before feeding to eng. also: do they require air-gapped image delivery or just VPC-with-no-internet? :thinking_face:
Akash: copied from the email: 'VPC peering to our account, no public egress except to our KMS endpoint, HSM for key storage (Thales), SOC2 + encryption-in-use audit logs, strict patching window (2am-4am PST). Expected steady RPS ~ 30 req/s with spikes to 200 qps, embedding sizes small.' no network diagram yet.
Tara: tagging from solutions eng — quick notes: Thales HSM will be a new integration path for us. need to verify supported key wrap APIs and latency implications for token signing. egress rule to a single customer-owned IP range is doable but we need to confirm routing and NAT behavior in the customer's VPC. also: are they expecting DB access from our pods?
Jess: Customer asked for data residency in us-west-2 and monthly key rotation with audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. They also flagged that some upstream teams expect mutual TLS to internal services.
Morgan: ok, proposal for triage: 1) collect network diagram + target CIDRs 2) confirm HSM vendor + certs 3) determine whether images are delivered via S3 cross-account or shipped air-gapped 4) list launch criteria + estimated effort. I made a quick template below — can solutions + sales fill the blanks?
Morgan: ```
Halcyon private intake checklist
- Customer: Halcyon Energy
- Region: us-west-2
- Deployment mode: private VPC (customer-managed)
- Must-have: VPC peering/privatelink, Thales HSM integration, no public egress except CIDRs X, monthly key rotation + SIEM logs, SOC2 evidence
- Nice-to-have: image airgap, mutal TLS to internal services (phase 2), extended retention for logs
- Traffic profile: steady 30 rps, spikes 200 rps
- Maintenance window: 02:00-04:00 PST
- Dependencies: network diagram, HSM certs/connector, legal SOW, infra-runbook, KMS credentials (ephemeral)
```
Tara: filling in gaps from our internal checklist: HSM connector work (3w), private networking config + NAT/PFs (1w), image delivery and signing (2w), QA + perf tuning for peak loads (2w). rough total: 8-10 engineer-weeks across infra + runtime teams. major unknown: Thales connector compatibility and signing latency — could add 2-3w if we need custom adapter.
Akash: thanks. any impact on pricing for the customer since this is vendor-specific HSM + restricted egress? they expect a Dedicated-like SOW but want private deployment pricing.
Morgan: pricing note: private deployment + HSM integration will go on an SOW addendum; we'll include engineering uplift + recurring support premium. product will map feature work into backlog as a scoped ticket; commercial will own SOW.
Tara: technical blockers we should surface now: 1) HSM vendor SDK compatibility; 2) CI/CD image signing and airgap process; 3) emergency access runbook (how do we patch if connectivity is cut?) — without those it's high risk for launch.
Jess: customer side will try to provide HSM test endpoint and network diagram by EOD Fri. they'll also confirm whether they can accept our managed connectors or insist on direct HSM appliance on their network.
Morgan: proposed launch criteria (for product backlog/acceptance):
- KMS/HSM integration verified with test vectors and <50ms signing latency in 95th percentile
- Private-network egress rules enforced and validated by network team
- Audit log delivery to customer's SIEM and retention policy validated
- Successful load test at 200 qps with <300ms p95 latency for gen calls
- Runbook + emergency rollback validated with customer ops
Once those are satisfied we can mark ticket 'ready for SOW & pilot'.
deploy-bot: created ticket PROD-PLAT-4721 (Halcyon private deploy intake) assigned to Tara, Morgan.
Akash: will update customer that a scoped SOW and timeline estimate (8–12 weeks) is coming after we get the HSM test endpoint and network diagram.
Tara: I'll slot this as high priority for the infra sprint edge work. if we get the HSM test endpoint by Monday I can put an initial spike in next sprint to validate APIs.
Morgan: next steps: Akash to collect diagram + HSM endpoint; Jess to confirm compliance docs; Tara to run spike; product to convert intake to backlog ticket with must-have scope and acceptance criteria. meeting to sync Tue 10am PST. :calendar:
